rationale: RangeSlider and Checkbox gain an opt-in chromium_refresh skin that paints Chromium's form-control theme, and their paint code moves from widgets.cpp into widgets/form_controls.cpp (added to the view source list). This is widget paint inside Pulp's own view layer, off by default and selected only by an explicit set_skin call; no design-import lowering, Chromium capture, renderer backend, asset or packaging authority moves.
tests: ctest --test-dir build -R 'Pulp.s platform form-control look does not pass'
